title: candidate
description: One candidate registered with the FEC, as the FEC's candidate master file lists them for the cycle. Partitioned by cycle.

cycle.description: The two-year election cycle, named by its even year.

source.description: Where the row comes from. `fec` for every row of v1.

jurisdiction.description: The regulator whose rules and ids the row follows. `US` (the FEC) for every row of v1.

name.description: The candidate's name, as the FEC lists it.

election_year.description: The election year of the candidate's filing.

office.description: The office sought, `H` House, `S` Senate or `P` President.

district.description: The House district, two digits; `00` for an at-large seat, the Senate and President.

status.description: The FEC candidate status (`C` statutory candidate, `N` not yet, `P` prior cycle …).

principal_committee_id.description: The FEC id of the candidate's principal campaign committee.

race_id.description: The race the candidate stands in this cycle, the `race` table's key; null for a filing that stands in no race of the cycle.

alias_of.description: For a second FEC id the same person holds for the same race, the id that holds their money; else null.
